title: 全球大超预期：中国区却掉队，差在哪？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We are getting these numbers crossing the wire right now. Start with the bottom line EPS for the fiscal third quarter.
segments.zh: 这些数据刚刚公布。先看第三财季的每股收益。

segments.en: $2.02 a share. A beat the street was looking for $1.89.
segments.zh: 每股2.02美元，超出市场预期的1.89美元。

segments.en: Revenue for the quarter coming in at $109.42 billion.
That's also a beat over $108.85 for the quarter.
segments.zh: 同样高于预期的1088.5亿美元。

segments.en: Services revenue looks like a little light at $30.7.
segments.zh: 服务收入略低于预期，为307亿美元。

segments.en: iPhone revenue, $54.25 slightly above what the street was looking for, relatively in line on wearables operating expenses slightly higher than what the street was looking for.
segments.zh: iPhone收入542.5亿美元，略高于预期，可穿戴设备基本符合预期，运营支出略高于预期。

segments.en: One number I'm also interested in here Emily was actually the greater China revenue.
segments.zh: 艾米丽，我还关注一个数据，就是大中华区收入。

segments.en: It did come in a little bit light, $18.8 billion street was looking for $19.5 billion.
segments.zh: 实际为188亿美元，略低于预期的195亿美元。

segments.en: But obviously the big question going forward isn't so much what these numbers look like in the third quarter but how much they change over the next couple of quarters with the introduction of some of these new products.
segments.zh: 但显然，未来的关键问题不在于第三季度的这些数字，而在于随着新产品的推出，未来几个季度这些数字会如何变化。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, if this quarter really in the quarters going forward really is a product story here then China is going to be important.
segments.zh: 是的，如果本季度以及未来几个季度真的以产品为主导，那么中国市场将非常重要。

segments.en: There's a lot of competition in that market that I think sometimes American consumers forget about just going over some of those numbers.
segments.zh: 那个市场竞争激烈，美国消费者有时会忽略这些数字。

segments.en: Again, greater China revenue still a slight miss here.
segments.zh: 大中华区营收仍略低于预期。

segments.en: America's revenue though beating estimates $45.78 billion.
segments.zh: 美国营收超出预期，达457.8亿美元。

segments.en: That's up 11% year over year and also beating estimates.
